stem.text: A wire is made from a metal of constant resistivity. There is a constant current in the wire.
Which statement about the potential difference across the wire is correct?

A.text: It is directly proportional to the length of the wire.

B.text: It is inversely proportional to the length of the wire.

C.text: It is directly proportional to the diameter of the wire.

D.text: It is inversely proportional to the diameter of the wire.
